{
  "verdict": "APPROVED",
  "summary": "The 10-minute Yahoo price cache implementation in api_watchlist_summary is clean, correct, and thread-safe under asyncio single worker architecture. It successfully mitigates the 2.5s Yahoo latency for stocks with insufficient local daily bars without side effects on real-time quotes.",
  "findings": [],
  "coverage": "Inspected cache lookup, TTL expiration check, cache population, logging format, empty/edge case handling, and unit test coverage in test_summary_calls_yahoo_only_for_missing.",
  "limitations": "Cache TTL expiration over time was verified by logic inspection rather than an automated mock of _time.time()."
}
